Guangzhou广州

The trading city: Canton Fair, wholesale markets and a lower cost base than Shenzhen.

Registered address
¥6k–20k / year
Typical setup
3–6 weeks
Region
Greater Bay Area
Best suited to
Import/export, wholesale, food and beverage, consumer goods and trading companies that need a real port and a real market.

Guangzhou has been China's trading city for two centuries, and the business culture still reflects it: pragmatic, price-sensitive, relationship-driven and less impressed by a foreign founder's pitch deck than by a confirmed order. The Canton Fair brings the world's buyers twice a year, and the wholesale markets around Zhanxi and Shahe supply much of it.

For a small foreign company, Guangzhou offers a lower cost base than Shenzhen or Shanghai and a dense network of freight forwarders, customs brokers and trading agents. The trade-off is a smaller pool of English-speaking technical talent.

What actually differs here?

Guangzhou is a city where the deal is done over dinner and the paperwork is done afterwards. That works only if the paperwork still gets done.

Tianhe is the premium address; Haizhu and Panyu are cheaper and popular with trading companies and small brands.

Before you commit to an address here

The figures on this page are ranges. District practice decides whether a specific address will register, bank and pass inspection — and it changes without much notice.

Take it to the counter: ask the district market regulator and the bank to confirm the address before you sign the lease, using the script in how to verify.

How to check it

Registration practice

How the paperwork actually goes in Guangzhou

Registry speed, address rules and the district-level differences that decide whether a plan is realistic.

Registering

Registration is through the municipal portal with district review. Tianhe and Haizhu are the default for foreign trading and service companies; Nansha, the southern district, offers incentives and a free-trade-zone port but is a long commute from the city centre.

Banking

Banks in Guangzhou are experienced with trade documentation and foreign-exchange settlement. A trading company should expect to explain its suppliers, its customers and its expected remittance pattern, and to provide contracts for the first transactions.

Work permits

Work permits are processed by the municipal science and technology bureau. Guangzhou is generally practical for Category B applicants, but the salary threshold and the requirement for a degree plus two years' experience still apply, and the company needs a tax record for renewals.

Address supply

¥6k–20k / year. Expect a lease, a property certificate and a utility bill in the company's name before a bank will look at the file.

Know before you commit

Three risks in this city

  • Importing goods on a tourist visa and invoicing through a friend's company: the customs record and the tax record will not match.
  • Assuming a Hong Kong company can hold the mainland import licence without a mainland entity.
  • Underpricing freight and customs brokerage, which are the real cost lines in a trading business.

Best suited to

Import/export, wholesale, food and beverage, consumer goods and trading companies that need a real port and a real market.
